note: Butler County Conservation Board park on the north edge of Parkersburg, beside Beaver Meadows Golf Course (enter by the golf course) and above Beaver Creek; on-site host. Grass pads among trees, set back from the creek beyond the park road. Fishing, canoe and kayak access above the dam, disc golf, two shelters. Pad lengths not posted. --Claude
